summary: Reconciled the complete F65 reviewed N-group merge and independent product-removal feature onto live base 2767fbf, preserved the existing live fixes, repaired lifecycle backup/reset coverage and legacy test harnesses, and verified the clean source candidate a5702d49 through focused, package, native D1, browser, and independent review evidence.
changes: Added paged, durable global conflict reviews for up to 1600 canonical actions, with explicit N-member keeper and field choices, frozen original-group economics, bounded continuation, and exact concurrency guards.
Added independent direct-removal receipts with permission tiers, approval, same-ID Undo/Redo, graph fingerprints, append-only evidence, and truthful replay/status partitions.
Added the accessible English/Khmer review UI and v2 transport while retaining the legacy exact-pair merge path and hiding removal controls without products.delete authority.
Added migration 0138 lifecycle tables to full backup/restore and product/full/factory reset ordering.
Adapted eleven legacy backend harnesses to the new route dependencies and verified that those commits contain test changes only.
Preserved the live F46 native query/finalizer, F57, F71, and customer-edit behavior while replaying the F65 chain instead of overwriting products.ts wholesale.
